title: Activation Keywords / Scan Depth entirely absent
reality: Custom agents support Activation Keywords (up to 100 phrases, customAgentActivationSettingsSchema) plus activationScanDepth (DEFAULT 5, MAX 200, packages/shared/src/constants/agent-activation.ts). The agent then runs ONLY when a keyword appears in that many recent messages; an empty box means run every time. Documented in docs/agents/custom-agents.md. Neither SKILL.md nor references/agents.md mentions it anywhere.
fix: Add an 'Activation Keywords (cost control)' subsection to references/agents.md and cite it from the SKILL.md anti-pattern "I'll build everything as custom agents" and decision-guide.md Q5. The skill repeatedly warns agents fire every turn and cost tokens, then never names the built-in mitigation — it presents a binary where a documented third option exists.

title: Persistent-state guidance contradicts variable macros
reality: SKILL.md decision item 8 says persistent structured state needs a 'Webhook tool + your own backend' because 'the engine's persistence is scoped to chats/characters/lorebooks'. macro-engine.ts:1326-1336 implements {{setvar::name::value}}, {{getvar::name}}, addvar, incvar, decvar — real in-engine state, documented in docs/prompts/macros.md.
fix: Amend SKILL.md item 8 and decision-guide.md Q7 to check variable macros BEFORE recommending a backend: dynamic variables cover per-chat counters, flags, and small structured state; webhook+backend is for data that outlives or spans chats, or is large or externally owned.

title: custom-agent.template.json behaviorally stale under v2.4.0
reality: assets/custom-agent.template.json ships "settings": {} with no contextSources key, while its promptTemplate claims 'You will receive: The latest assistant message, Recent context'. Under #4305 an agent with no stored contextSources falls back to chatHistory-only — no character card, persona, lorebook, summary, author notes, tracker data, or recalled memories.
fix: Add an explicit contextSources block with all eight keys to settings in assets/custom-agent.template.json so the template teaches the opt-in model rather than inheriting the narrow default by omission. This is the single highest-impact remaining edit — the template is exactly what a user copies.

title: assets/ templates unreachable from the skill
reality: Four starter templates ship in assets/ and README.md advertises them, but grep for 'assets/' returns 0 matches in SKILL.md and 0 across every references/ file. Nothing instructs Claude to read or offer them.
fix: Add a starter-templates entry to SKILL.md — in the 'When to consult bundled references' table and/or at ideation step 5, where the skill already offers to produce a card or tool definition. High impact for trivial effort: the assets exist and are good but are currently dead weight.

title: Regex Apply Mode / Placement / Depth undocumented
reality: regex.schema.ts defines applyMode, placement, promptOnly, minDepth, maxDepth, order, trimStrings, findRegex, replaceString, flags, targetCharacterIds — references/custom-tools.md documents ZERO of these names. docs/extending/regex-scripts.md: a NEW SCRIPT STARTS ON 'Only Display' (display only; saved message and future model context unchanged). Critical exception — a User Input script on Only Display or Both rewrites the message right before sending, so it changes what is actually saved and sent; there is no display-only mode for outgoing user messages. Depth counts BACKWARD from the newest message (depth 0); min>max blocks saving.
fix: Add a field table plus an Apply Mode subsection to the Regex Scripts section of references/custom-tools.md. The Only Display default means a script written from the skill's current advice appears to do nothing to the model, and the user-input exception is a genuine data-mutating footgun. SKILL.md routes regex questions here, so coverage should match that promise.

title: Entry position table stale — omits value 7 (Outlet) and outletName
reality: lorebook.schema.ts:180-187 refines position to 0, 1, 2, OR 7 with the message 'Position must be Before, After, At Depth, or Outlet', plus outletName (trimmed, max 200, default ''). references/lorebooks.md line 50 documents '0, 1, or 2' and never mentions Outlet. docs/prompts/macros.md:123 confirms {{outlet::name}} inserts entries whose Position is Outlet and whose name matches EXACTLY, case-sensitively.
fix: Correct the position row to 0/1/2/7, add an outletName row, and document the case-sensitive {{outlet::name}} pairing. A factual error in a schema table that also hides the engine's most precise content-placement feature.

title: CUSTOM_AGENT_CAPABILITY_IDS incomplete — 8 of 13 listed
reality: packages/shared/src/types/agent.ts defines 13 capability IDs. references/agents.md line 220 lists 8, omitting change_backgrounds, change_sprites, control_media, control_haptics, and edit_about_me.
fix: Replace the inline list with all 13 in source order. The five omissions are exactly the media/scene capabilities most relevant to ideation advice (backgrounds, sprites, music, haptics, About Me), so the gap actively misleads.

title: Folders double as group-chat rosters
reality: docs/characters/library-organization.md has a dedicated section 'Folders double as group chat rosters'. A character folder is not merely organizational — it can seed a group chat's cast. references/character-cards.md treats folders as organization only.
fix: Add to references/character-cards.md and cross-reference from the group-chat material in architecture.md. 'Organize a cast into a folder, then open it as a group chat' is a concrete workflow the skill cannot currently offer, and it changes how to advise structuring a multi-character project.

title: Outside-contributor approval gate not documented
reality: CONTRIBUTING.md:59-60 — PRs from active Pasta-Devs members or owners need no separate human approval and members with merge permission may merge into staging; outside and first-time contributors may submit only to staging and need an approving review from owner SpicyMarinara specifically, in addition to automated gates. v2.4.0 (#4361) stopped PR description edits, CodeRabbit comments, and non-owner reviews from RECREATING that gate.
fix: Add an 'Approval and merge rules' subsection to Mode B of SKILL.md. High value for the skill's stated beginner audience: a first-timer needs to know their PR requires SpicyMarinara, and that editing the description no longer resets the gate.

title: Z.AI and Atlas Cloud missing from the image/video provider list
reality: v2.4.0 (#4350) added Z.AI as a NATIVE Image Generation service (GLM-Image, CogView 4, model-aware aspect sizing, authenticated native requests). v2.3.5 (#3989) added Atlas Cloud as an image AND video service with curated starter models, async job polling, connection tests, and Game/scene-video routing. references/architecture.md line 249 lists neither; Z.AI appears only as a TEXT provider (GLM-5.2).
fix: Add both to the 'Image gen:' line, and Atlas Cloud to the Video Generation subsection. Call out the Z.AI distinction explicitly — it already appeared as a text provider, so a reader could reasonably conclude image support did not exist.

title: Card/Persona version history entirely undocumented
reality: v2.3.5 (#4040): restoring an older version first saves the CURRENT card to history so the newer version is never lost; each saved version keeps its own edit timestamp; comparison view wraps long unbroken text. v2.4.0 (#4040): the live card appears as the first explicitly-labelled current revision, with stable sequence numbers and second-precision times. references/character-cards.md has no match for 'revision' or 'version history'.
fix: Add a 'Version history' subsection to references/character-cards.md. It is the safety net that makes iterating on a card low-risk and the correct answer to 'what if the Card Evolution Auditor makes a change I don't like'.

title: Agent Budget settings (contextSize / maxTokens) undocumented
reality: DEFAULT_AGENT_CONTEXT_SIZE = 5 (recent messages the agent reads) and DEFAULT_AGENT_MAX_TOKENS = 4096 with MIN 128 / MAX 32768 (agent.schema.ts and types/agent.ts:521-524), independently confirmed by docs/agents/custom-agents.md 'Other settings you can adjust'. references/agents.md mentions contextSize only in passing with no defaults or range.
fix: Add an 'Agent Budget' subsection to references/agents.md. Tie it to the Context Sources note: disabling chatHistory forces agentContextSize to 0, so the two controls interact.

title: {{agent::TYPE}} macro and 'Add as Prompt Section' — agent output injection path missing
reality: {{agent::TYPE}} inserts an agent's cached output into a prompt, rendering only after the agent has run (macro-engine.ts:389; docs/prompts/macros.md:113,119 — easiest added via Preset Editor > Add Section > Agent). Custom agents also expose an 'Add as Prompt Section' toggle publishing their latest output as an injectable preset section (docs/agents/custom-agents.md).
fix: Document both in references/agents.md and character-cards.md. Together they qualify the skill's claim that prompt assembly is closed to user extension — agent output has a supported, first-class injection route.

title: Impersonate feature and its per-chat fields undocumented
reality: chat.schema.ts carries impersonate, impersonatePromptTemplate, impersonateConnectionId, impersonatePresetId, impersonateBlockAgents. v2.4.0 refined Impersonate with server-backed prompt templates shared across browsers, read-only built-in previews, full-view editing, and a Quick Replies link. docs/chats/guided-and-impersonate.md is a dedicated guide. The references mention 'Impersonate' only inside the CYOA bullet.
fix: Add an Impersonate subsection to references/architecture.md citing the guide. impersonateBlockAgents is architecturally notable — an impersonated turn can deliberately bypass the agent pipeline.

title: Push Story relocation of Narrative Director mode
reality: v2.3.5 moved the Natural/Random progression choice ONTO the Push Story button; clicking it opens a Naturally/Randomly selector arming the chosen mode for the next response, replacing controls in Chat Settings > Agents > Narrative Director, the add-agent setup, and the editor's Story Push Mode default. chat.schema.ts stores narrativeDirectorMode as per-chat state, confirming the relocation.
fix: Extend the `director` bullet in references/agents.md. Note the armed mode is per-chat state, not a global agent setting — precisely why the old global control was removed. Any click-path advice pointing at the old location is stale.

title: Markdown preview toggles on card, persona, and lorebook fields
reality: v2.4.0 (#4306) added Markdown preview toggles to Character, Persona, AND lorebook text fields, and rendered formatted card text in library detail views.
fix: Note in references/character-cards.md and references/lorebooks.md. Practical for authoring advice: users can verify markdown in the editor instead of round-tripping through a chat.

title: Settings Profile contents and Game-mode exclusion missing
reality: docs/chats/settings-profiles.md: a profile holds connection, prompt preset (the 'prompt source' in Conversation), agents and tools, translation, Memory Recall, Advanced Parameters, and other reusable options. It does NOT carry characters, persona, lorebooks, sprites, summary, tags, scene prompt, or conversation history. Profiles work in Conversation and Roleplay only — GAME MODE DOES NOT SHOW THE PROFILE CONTROLS. Also: a prompt preset can be one item INSIDE a settings profile, not an alternative to it.
fix: Expand the Settings Profiles note in references/architecture.md with the includes/excludes list, the Game-mode exclusion, and the containment relationship. Recommending a settings profile to a Game-mode user is advice that cannot be followed.

title: Named prompt options / Prompt Mode variants undocumented
reality: A single custom agent can hold several named prompt variants; each chat picks one via a Prompt Mode dropdown without editing the agent globally. With none defined, the chat menu shows only the default prompt (docs/agents/custom-agents.md).
fix: Document in references/agents.md. It is the supported way to get per-chat behavioral variation from ONE agent, and should be recommended instead of cloning an agent per variant — which the skill currently has no answer for.

title: settings.triggerLorebooksForAgentCalls undocumented
reality: agent-executor.ts (1565, 1615, 1689) and generate.routes.ts:3292 gate lorebook activation for agent calls on settings.triggerLorebooksForAgentCalls === true, applied to custom agents.
fix: Document alongside the Context Sources table in references/agents.md. Distinguish it from activatedLorebookEntries: that passes entries which already fired this turn, while this causes the agent call itself to trigger lorebook scanning. Users conflate the two.

title: {{outlet::name}} lorebook positioning macro missing
reality: {{outlet::name}} inserts content from lorebook entries whose Position is Outlet and whose Outlet name matches exactly — CASE-SENSITIVE (macro-engine.ts:392; docs/prompts/macros.md:123).
fix: Add to the macro list in character-cards.md and the entry-position material in lorebooks.md. It is the answer to 'how do I control exactly where this entry lands in the prompt', and the case-sensitivity gotcha is worth stating.

title: Entry trimming behavior at token budget undocumented
reality: docs/lorebooks/token-budgets.md has a 'How entries get trimmed' section describing what happens when activated entries exceed the budget. references/lorebooks.md documents tokenBudget as a knob but never the trimming rule.
fix: Add a 'What happens at budget' paragraph. The skill already tells users to tune tokenBudget for large lorebooks; without the trimming rule they cannot predict WHICH entries get dropped — the actionable half.

title: Re-vectorizing after an embedding-model change undocumented
reality: docs/lorebooks/semantic-search.md documents 'Before you start: pick an embedding source' and 'Re-vectorizing after you change models'. references/lorebooks.md covers embeddings and excludeFromVectorization but not the operational requirement.
fix: Add to the embeddings material in references/lorebooks.md. A real failure mode — semantic search silently degrades after switching embedding models until entries are re-vectorized.

title: Bulk import/export and whole-SillyTavern-folder import missing
reality: docs/lorebooks/import-export.md documents bulk import, bulk export, and 'Importing a whole SillyTavern folder'. references/lorebooks.md covers single-lorebook SillyTavern import only.
fix: Add to references/lorebooks.md. The skill actively recommends migrating from SillyTavern rather than rebuilding, so the bulk path is what most users will actually need.

title: Embedded vs linked lorebooks — the embed path undocumented
reality: docs/lorebooks/linking-to-characters.md documents 'Embed a lorebook into a character card', 'Assign an existing lorebook', and 'Managing an embedded lorebook'. references/lorebooks.md covers characterId/characterIds scoping but not the embed-into-card path that makes a card self-contained for sharing.
fix: Add an 'Embedded vs linked' subsection. Pairs directly with the v2.4.0 embedded-lorebook visibility toggle already documented, and explains where those embedded books come from.

title: Reserved built-in tool names not listed
reality: docs/extending/custom-tools.md 'Reserved names': a custom tool name cannot match a built-in — roll_dice, update_game_state, set_expression, trigger_event, search_lorebook, web_search, update_about_me, among others. Saving one yields '"your_name" is a reserved built-in tool name.' Two custom tools also cannot share a name.
fix: Add the reserved set to references/custom-tools.md beside the existing snake_case rule — the other half of that constraint, and it prevents a confusing save failure.

title: Character Tavern / zTXt compressed card parsing missing
reality: v2.3.5 (#4002): Character Tavern cards store data in COMPRESSED zTXt PNG chunks, which every Marinara card parser (Card Browser, file/URL import, SillyTavern bulk import) now reads alongside tEXt and iTXt. Re-exporting such a character strips the stale compressed data instead of shipping outdated card JSON.
fix: Add to the PNG card-import material in references/character-cards.md — names the three chunk types Marinara reads and explains why re-exported Character Tavern cards used to carry stale JSON.

title: Macro coverage is a small fraction of the 58 implemented
reality: macro-engine.ts defines 58 macros; the references cover roughly a dozen. Beyond the variable/agent/outlet families, uncovered ones include {{roll:XdY}} (resolves even typed directly into the message box), {{lastGenerationType}} (labels: normal, continue, regenerate, impersonate, guided, autonomous, turn_game, preview, game_setup, lorebook_scan, …), {{charSysInfo}}, {{charPostHistory}}, {{idle_duration}}, {{timezone}}, {{trim}}/{{trimStart}}, {{uppercase}}/{{lowercase}}, {{noop}}.
fix: Add a categorised summary table (Context, Variables, Random, Text-transform, Profile, Relocation) plus a pointer to docs/prompts/macros.md as authoritative. The current partial list reads as complete — that is the actual problem. {{lastGenerationType}} pairs well with the conditional operators the skill already documents.

title: 'Add persona as character' conversion undocumented
reality: docs/characters/personas.md documents an 'Add persona as character' action converting a persona into a character card. references/character-cards.md frames personas and characters as parallel types with 'similar fields, opposite roles' and no bridge.
fix: Add to the persona-vs-character section. Direct answer to 'I built this as a persona but now want to chat WITH them', which the current framing implies requires manual rebuilding.

title: Library organization surface missing (favorites, tags, bulk ops)
reality: docs/characters/library-organization.md documents Favorites and tag chips, tag filtering, folders, and 'Bulk select, export, and delete'; docs/characters/import-export.md documents exporting many characters at once. The `fav` and `tags` fields exist in character.schema.ts. None of these workflows appear in the references.
fix: Add a 'Library organization' subsection to references/character-cards.md. Relevant to migration advice — the skill recommends SillyTavern migration but never explains managing the resulting large library.

title: Sprite authoring workflow not covered
reality: docs/characters/sprites.md documents 'Generating sprites with AI', 'Cleaning up sprite backgrounds', 'Exporting sprites', and 'How sprites show up in your chat'. The references cover Sprites->Clips and the Expression Engine agent but not sprite authoring.
fix: Add to references/character-cards.md, cross-referencing the `expression` agent. Completes a path currently covered only at the consumption end (an agent picks a sprite) without the production end.

title: Illustrator per-chat Images Per Generation missing
reality: v2.3.5 (#3966) added a per-chat 'Images Per Generation' setting to Illustrator in Conversation, Roleplay, and Game — up to four sequential variants through the existing provider queue and gallery pipeline. Generated image attachments were also enlarged while staying within the chat viewport.
fix: Add to the `illustrator` bullet in references/agents.md. Relevant to cost advice: raising it multiplies image spend per trigger.

title: Roleplay Gallery Animate single-shot animation director missing
reality: v2.4.0 (#4311): the selected Prompt Model now plans motion, camera behavior, supported dialogue, sound effects, ambience, and an ending hold from the exchange behind the Illustrator image; the existing image remains frame zero and Game Storyboard behavior is unchanged. Instructions are editable under Settings > Generations > Video Generation Prompt Overrides with ${durationSeconds} support.
fix: Document in references/agents.md near the storyboard/illustrator entries and cross-reference architecture.md's scene-video section. Animate is now model-directed, not a bare image-to-video call, and its prompt is user-overridable. State explicitly that Game Storyboard did NOT change — the two are not interchangeable.

title: Per-chat Illustrator image-connection override only in SKILL.md deltas
reality: v2.4.0 (#4057) added a Roleplay Illustrator image connection override in Chat Settings, separate from the prompt-writing connection, falling back to the Illustrator Agent's configured image model. SKILL.md's deltas section names it; references/agents.md and architecture.md's Connection section do not.
fix: Add to the `illustrator` bullet in agents.md and the Connection Defaults paragraph in architecture.md. Emphasise the split: one connection writes the prompt, a different one renders the image.

title: includeHiddenContext under-explained
reality: docs/extending/custom-tools.md dedicates a section to 'Include hidden chat context' — the setting v2.4.0's import hardening forcibly disables on imported webhooks. references/custom-tools.md names the field in the schema and import note but never explains what it exposes or when enabling it is legitimate.
fix: Expand coverage in references/custom-tools.md: what it exposes, why it is the reason imported webhooks are force-disabled, and when a self-authored tool genuinely needs it.

title: Regex targetCharacterIds contradicts documented per-character scoping
reality: references/custom-tools.md states regex scripts are scoped 'per-character (Character editor's regex section) and per-preset'. regex.schema.ts carries targetCharacterIds (an array) on the script itself — one script targeting a SET of characters, a different and more flexible model.
fix: Verify actual behavior against the client, then correct the Scope bullet. If a script can target multiple characters by ID, the current description understates it and misleads anyone building shared formatting rules across a cast.

title: Extension approval acknowledgements and payload fields not named
reality: personal-extension.schema.ts:100-101 requires acknowledgeSandboxedCode: z.literal(true) on every approval plus an optional acknowledgeFullPageAccess: z.literal(true) for full-page packages. Payload fields are runtime (default 'client'), code, js, css, serverJs, capabilities, contentHash, version; runtime === 'server' requires non-empty serverJs (lines 61-64). references/extensions.md covers these concepts narratively without naming the fields.
fix: Add the two acknowledgement fields and a payload-shape block to references/extensions.md. The literal(true) requirement is the schema-level proof the disclosure cannot be skipped programmatically, and it makes the file's manifest examples schema-accurate rather than illustrative.

title: activationConditions operators and filter mode not enumerated
reality: activationConditionSchema (lorebook.schema.ts:38-42) defines operator as equals, not_equals, contains, not_contains, gt, lt over {field, operator, value}. lorebookFilterModeSchema (line 25) is any|include|exclude, the mode governing additionalMatchingSources. references/lorebooks.md describes both fields without listing either enum.
fix: List the six operators and the three filter modes in the respective rows of references/lorebooks.md. Without them these fields are undocumented in practice — a user cannot author a condition from the current description, and include vs exclude changes activation semantics substantially.

title: Entry role field coverage unverified
reality: lorebook.schema.ts defines role: z.enum(['system','user','assistant']).default('system') on the entry, controlling the message role injected content is attributed to.
fix: Confirm whether the field table in references/lorebooks.md carries `role`; if not, add it with its default. Role attribution materially affects how strongly a model weighs injected lore — directly relevant to the skill's prompt-design advice.

title: Conversation character schedule export/import missing
reality: v2.4.0 (#4414) added validated JSON export and import for Conversation character schedules. Imports load as unsaved DRAFTS, preserve the existing schedule until explicitly saved, and move restored routines to the current week.
fix: Document in references/architecture.md and cross-reference character-cards.md, which already covers the schedule field. Draft-until-saved and shift-to-current-week are both non-obvious.

title: Game Mode character-sheet Retry not documented
reality: v2.4.0 (#4048) added Retry to Game Mode character-sheet editing: regenerates only the selected Persona or party member from their card and current campaign history, keeps the result as an UNSAVED DRAFT, and preserves the original unless saved.
fix: Add to the Game Mode material in architecture.md, cross-referenced from character-cards.md. The draft-unless-saved semantics match the schedule-import and card-version patterns — worth noting as a consistent engine convention rather than three isolated behaviors.

title: Radial-gauge tracker layout only in decision-guide
reality: v2.4.0 added an optional radial-gauge layout for Persona and Character tracker stats with editable icons, percentage readouts, and low-stat warnings. references/decision-guide.md mentions it; the character-tracker and persona-stats bullets in references/agents.md do not.
fix: Add to both tracker bullets in references/agents.md, tied to the structured {name,value,max,color} stat shape those entries already describe.

title: Cached prompt injections panel undocumented
reality: docs/agents/approvals-and-agent-suite.md documents a 'Cached prompt injections panel' alongside the Agent Write Approval modal and Character Card Update review. references/agents.md covers the Agent Suite but not this surface.
fix: Add a note to the Agent Suite subsection. Useful for debugging 'why is this agent's old output still in my prompt', currently unanswerable from the references.

title: Three memory surfaces not disambiguated
reality: docs/agents/memory.md frames 'two memory systems' — Memory Recall (embedding-based, per-chat, own embedding source) and Chat Summary (Roleplay). With Long-Term Memory now a catalog package and recalledMemories a custom-agent context source, three related concepts exist and no reference draws the boundary in one place. chat.schema.ts also carries daySummaries, arguably a fourth.
fix: Add a 'memory surfaces' orientation block to agents.md or architecture.md: Memory Recall, Chat Summary, the Long-Term Memory package, and daySummaries — plus which of them recalledMemories actually feeds.

title: decision-guide heading says 'The Nine Questions' but there are ten
reality: references/decision-guide.md line 14 reads '## The Nine Questions'. The section contains 1-9 PLUS the newly added 6b (UI functionality / Personal Extensions). The count was not updated when 6b was inserted during the v2.4.0 sync.
fix: Either renumber 6b to 7 and shift the rest, or retitle to 'The Decision Questions'. Retitling is the safer minimal fix. Self-inflicted this cycle — correct it in the same cycle.

title: SKILL.md hierarchy (8 items) and decision-guide (10 questions) no longer correspond
reality: SKILL.md's decision hierarchy has 8 numbered items; decision-guide.md has 1-9 plus 6b. The mapping diverged when the UI question split into 6 (looks) and 6b (functionality) while SKILL.md folded both into a three-tier item 7. SKILL.md says 'See references/decision-guide.md for the full version', implying an item-for-item correspondence that no longer holds.
fix: Align the numbering, or change SKILL.md's pointer to state that decision-guide.md expands and re-splits these questions rather than mirroring them.

title: No Personal Extension starter template
reality: assets/ covers character cards, custom agents, webhook tools, and lorebook entries. With Personal Extensions restored and now a first-class ideation surface (SKILL.md item 7, decision-guide 6b), there is no extension starter — despite the contribution descriptor being the most error-prone thing to hand-write given the fixed control vocabulary and capabilities field.
fix: Add assets/personal-extension.template.js with a registerContribution panel skeleton, an onEvent handler writing to marinara.storage, a marinara.onCleanup call, and a capabilities block showing the explicit empty array that keeps a package in the safe runtime. Reference it from references/extensions.md.

title: custom-agent template's {{message}} placeholder is broken — VERIFIED
reality: CONFIRMED by source trace. assets/custom-agent.template.json's promptTemplate ends with 'The message:\n{{message}}'. Agent templates render via renderAgentPromptTemplate (agent-executor.ts:263), which calls resolveMacros with buildAgentPromptMacroContext — that context exposes user, char, characters, variables, lastInput, chatId, characterProfiles, characterFields, and has NO 'message' key (grep for 'message:' in the builder returns 0). {{message}} is absent from all 58 macros in macro-engine.ts, so it is never substituted and reaches the model as the literal string '{{message}}'. The correct macro is {{input}} — 'Most recent user message', backed by ctx.lastInput, substituted at macro-engine.ts:1764.
fix: Replace {{message}} with {{input}} in assets/custom-agent.template.json. This defect predates the v2.4.0 sync — anyone who built an agent from this template has been sending a literal placeholder to the model. Escalated from med to high on confirmation.

title: Attaching tools to an agent covered from only one side
reality: docs/extending/custom-tools.md has a dedicated 'Attaching tools to an agent' section. references/custom-tools.md now covers the all-vs-narrowed tool rule but not the agent-attachment flow in its own right; references/agents.md approaches the same relationship only from the agent side.
fix: Add an 'Attaching tools to an agent' note to references/custom-tools.md, cross-linked with the tool-using-agents section of agents.md.

title: Generated-image result URL restriction and NovelAI ZIP bounds undocumented
reality: v2.4.0 restricted private generated-image result URLs to the configured provider's exact scheme, hostname, and port — public CDN results still work, but redirects from a trusted local image provider can no longer reach another private service. v2.4.0 also bounded NovelAI ZIP image decompression to 64 MiB with declared-vs-actual output matching.
fix: Add to the security material in references/custom-tools.md or architecture.md. Relevant to anyone running a local image provider behind a proxy — a previously-working redirect now fails closed and must be diagnosable.

title: generationGuide / generationGuideSource fields undocumented
reality: chat.schema.ts defines generationGuide and generationGuideSource as per-chat fields. No reference mentions either. They sit alongside narrativeDirectorMode, suggesting the guided-generation / Push Story path owns them.
fix: Confirm the owning surface against the client before writing, then document in references/architecture.md. Do not infer purpose from the field names alone.

title: daySummaries and continueAddsNewline undocumented
reality: chat.schema.ts carries daySummaries (per-chat day-level summary structure, distinct from Chat Summary) and continueAddsNewline (whether /continue inserts a newline).
fix: Add both to the chat-object field notes in references/architecture.md. daySummaries matters most — it is a further summary-shaped concept beyond Chat Summary and Memory Recall, and the references imply only two exist.

title: Noodle handle uniqueness, mobile-layout rule, and image skipping missing
reality: v2.4.0: Noodle/NoodleR switch to mobile layouts whenever the CENTER PANE falls below desktop width — including when sidebars shrink it on a desktop. (#4056) enforced case-insensitive globally unique public Noodle handles across Personas and Characters, with deterministic suffixes for auto-created profiles and reconciliation of older collisions. (#4310) skips corrupt/undecodable timeline images before captioning rather than forwarding invalid bytes.
fix: Add to the Noodle section of references/architecture.md. Handle uniqueness is the most useful — it explains auto-suffixed handles, which users read as a bug.

title: Backup & Restore guide not cited alongside automatic backups
reality: docs/data/backup-and-restore.md is the authoritative guide for the surface v2.4.0 extended with rotating automatic backups. The skill documents the new backups but cites no guide, and the Data Storage section still frames backup as 'copy DATA_DIR/storage'.
fix: Cite the guide from the Data Storage section of references/architecture.md and soften the copy-the-directory framing now that a first-class scheduled backup exists with UI-visible run/failure state.

title: Docs tree paths not enumerated for lookup
reality: The engine docs form a structured tree — docs/chats/ (branches, chat-settings, connected-chats, export-import, group-chats, guided-and-impersonate, managing-chats, messages, peek-prompt, sending-and-streaming, settings-profiles, slash-commands), docs/data/, docs/settings/, docs/agents/, docs/extending/, docs/prompts/, docs/development/. SKILL.md notes the tree exists but names no files.
fix: Add a compact path map to SKILL.md's 'Core operating principle' section or references/architecture.md. Turns 'check the docs' into a directly actionable fetch.

title: Ideation anti-pattern should offer keyword-gating
reality: SKILL.md's anti-pattern "I'll build everything as custom agents" warns agents fire every turn and cost tokens, advising them only for genuine per-turn automation. Activation Keywords with scan depth (default 5, max 200) gate an agent to relevant scenes — the documented middle path.
fix: Amend the anti-pattern to offer keyword-gating rather than dropping the agent. Currently a binary where a third option exists. Same root cause as finding 1.

title: Set as avatar from Gallery missing

title: Playwright fixture isolation detail could be sharper
reality: v2.4.0 isolated desktop and mobile Playwright servers AND fixture data, made help tooltips non-blocking, kept focused mobile composers open during history scrolling, and aligned appearance/Tracker smoke checks with live application state. SKILL.md mentions the isolation parenthetically.
